RagShortTexts: The House of Toulouse once ruled Occitania under the sun cross, now merging into Capetian.

Variants.Content: Bearing the hollowed golden sun cross, the House of Toulouse ruled the vibrant lands of Occitania for generations. Following the Albigensian Crusade and the Treaty of Paris, Countess Jeanne was wedded to Alphonse of Poitiers, setting the massive southern feudal principality on course for absorption by Paris.
The University of Toulouse was founded under treaty terms to train orthodox theologians against heresy, yet troubadours still sing of ancient southern liberties in shaded cloisters.
Watermills on the Garonne turn as ever, but royal bailiffs speaking northern French now audit grain tithes, checking church attendance for heresy.
